title: One Beep Each
caption: Point your camera at a barcode, hear the beep, and it's in Fridgeroo 📲 Free, no download: fridgeroo.netlify.app
why: Hype slot. No 'typing' premise (keeps it apart from receipt #3); barcode named in sub + 📷 title so the feature is clear in 1 s; 6 items so every BEEP lands on a half-beat. Trap 140 unused in last 10. Hashtags share only #fridgeroo with #1, #4 and Monday. Judge: caption no longer says 'added to your fridge' (it's added to the app).
